title: SimulatedReality
description: Make your server more realistic and fun!
body:
![A image of show](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0cc971f3ddd5e547d04b74a9d4d09c6b843bb36a.png)

###                             Simulated Reality
###          ----------- Make your server more realistic and fun!

## **The simulated sections are as follows**
**_Zombie bleeding ( Special Effects )
Player bleeding ( Special Effects )
Snowball ( Special Effects )
The player falls into the water from a height ( Special Effects )
The player falls into the lava from a height ( Special Effects )
If the player runs for a long time, he will have a sweat effect
( Special Effects )
Multiple placements in a short time can be tiring
When the grass is destroyed, it grows back
Fire spreads and burns on top of grass blocks
If a skeleton is attacked, there is a chance that fall bone
Weather_**
## **Command**
/sr
/simulatedreality
Permission:
--- simulatedreality.reload


For a better use experience, it is recommended to use a Minecraft server version of 1.18 or later
I'll update it every once in a while to update more details out of it.
Thanks for download.

If you like this plugin then give me a thumbs up
